primitives.name: Model Freeze Guardrail
primitives.verbatim_quote: # MODEL_VERSION baseline — FROZEN This file is the model-freeze guardrail's escape hatch for the case where the current `MODEL_VERSION` is the intentional locked-in baseline and no scoring weights have changed since the last implemented calibration proposal.
primitives.assumptions: No scoring weight changes since last calibration proposal; version bump implies either cosmetic or justified recalibration.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When MODEL_VERSION increases without proper calibration proposal, historical confidence numbers become invalid.

layer2.mapping: Maps version consistency to Bayesian calibration integrity; ensures P(win) reliability across model versions.
layer2.telemetry: Audit trail of calibration proposals and version locks.

primitives.name: Calibration Proposal Audit
primitives.verbatim_quote: Add a `CalibrationProposal` row to `packages/db/prisma/seed.ts` with the new `modelVersion` and `status: "IMPLEMENTED"` along with the observation + change that justified the bump.
primitives.assumptions: Each version bump must be justified by empirical observation and documented in a proposal.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure to log proposal results in unverifiable confidence recalibration.

layer2.mapping: Derives trustable P(win) from empirical calibration logs; enables retroactive pick validation.
layer2.telemetry: Database entries for modelVersion and status.

primitives.name: Isotonic Calibration Map
primitives.verbatim_quote: The heuristic scoring weights in `packages/prediction-engine/src/scoring.ts` are UNCHANGED from the v5.0.0 baseline — the only change is that a validated isotonic map turns the raw confidence score into a calibrated P(win) at the display/conviction boundary, gated by CALIBRATION_ADJUSTMENTS_ENABLED.
primitives.assumptions: Scoring weights unchanged; isotonic map preserves monotonicity of confidence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Disabling CALIBRATION_ADJUSTMENTS_ENABLED disables calibrated P(win) output.

layer2.mapping: Maps raw confidence to calibrated probability via isotonic regression; maintains logical consistency of predictions.
layer2.telemetry: Output P(win) values from calibrated confidence scores.
